items.subject: Grocery: GUARDS FAILED - board not published - 2026-09-23
evidence: grocery/ad-cycle-log.txt [2026-09-23T08:20:44] 'HOLD  a guard condemns the HELD value itself on vegetable-oil|Sam's Club (0.0373), so the last verified price is not safe to show either: HARD FAIL: 1.94x factor  vegetable-oil / Sam's Club  board=0.0373 link=0.0723' then 'GUARDS-COMPLETE hard=2 warn=19 disposition=hold' and 'GUARDS FAILED - board NOT republished'

re-measure today: [2026-09-25T08:15:35] 'guards: GUARDS-COMPLETE hard=0 warn=19 disposition=quarantined'; [08:16:43] 'QUARANTINED - 3 cell(s) held ... every other cell publishes'; grocery/out/chain-verdict.json 'verdict: quarantine', 'quarantined: 3'. 09-23 09:54 and 09-24 16:58 also ended 'disposition=quarantined'. So the instance does not reproduce.

grocery/cell-quarantine-lib.ps1:254-261 (Get-TcGuardsDisposition): a covered cell whose VALUE finding equals the held last-good per_unit adds a HOLD for the whole board, rather than withholding that one cell
items.root_cause: one cell holds the whole board: when the last verified value a quarantine held is itself condemned on the verify pass, Get-TcGuardsDisposition returns HOLD for the board instead of withholding the cell, which is the one-bad-item-holds-the-board shape Brad's 2026-09-21 ruling forbids (a held cell shows its last verified price, or is withheld).

root_fix.what: a condemned HELD value withholds its cell, not the board
root_fix.exact_change: Get-TcGuardsDisposition (cell-quarantine-lib.ps1:258): instead of adding a board HOLD, return the cell in a new 'reapply_withhold' list; guards/apply-cell-quarantine re-applies once with that cell forced to WITHHELD (reason 'the held value was itself condemned'), then guards runs again and must exit 4. A second condemnation after the forced withhold, or a cell that cannot be withheld, still HOLDS. The breaker counts are unchanged.

items.leaves_open: nothing inside the disposition; the other hold routes (unscoped failure, breaker) are by design

prevention.what: the emitting decision withholds a cell whose held value is condemned instead of holding the board
prevention.exact_change: as root_fix.exact_change: Get-TcGuardsDisposition returns reapply_withhold for a covered cell whose value finding equals the held per_unit; the board HOLD stays only for an unscoped failure, the breaker, or a cell condemned after its forced withhold

proof.guard_or_fixture: grocery/test-cell-quarantine.ps1 (new MUST FIRE + CLEAN TWIN cases)
proof.must_fire_case: frozen 09-23 shape: board with vegetable-oil|Sam's Club covered last-good 0.0373 and a factor finding bad_per_unit 0.0373 -> disposition is reapply_withhold naming that cell, NOT hold
proof.clean_twin: a covered cell whose finding is on a different value (0.0625 vs held 0.1353, energy-drinks|Family Fare) stays covered and the disposition is quarantined, and an unscoped failure still returns hold
